description.p: Zedis is a native, high-performance Redis GUI client built in Rust with GPUI, the rendering engine behind the Zed editor. Every pixel is drawn on the GPU: browsing millions of keys stays at 60+ FPS with a minimal memory footprint — no Electron involved.

It understands your data: values are auto-decompressed (LZ4, Snappy, GZIP, ZSTD) and decoded as JSON/JSONPath, Protobuf, MessagePack, timestamps, images or hex, with purpose-built viewers for every Redis type and module — Streams with live tail, Vector Set with KNN search, Geo maps, Bloom/Cuckoo filters, Time Series, RediSearch and more.

ul.li: Real-time observability: live metrics, memory analyzer with recommendations, Slow Log, MONITOR and value search
Connect to anything: TLS/SSL, SSH tunnels, Cluster and Sentinel
Privacy-first: connection metadata stays in a local file, secrets are encrypted, no telemetry
Power-user tools: command palette, redis-cli with completion, batch mode, cross-server copy and diff
8 interface languages, light and dark themes

screenshot.caption: Key browser with namespace tree and syntax-highlighted value editor
Memory analyzer with Top-N table, TTL histogram and recommendations
